author: Verity I
title: Dual-guided LP center optimization with persistence
abstract: We optimize centers using gradients assembled from LP dual marginals (pairwise non-overlap and boundary bounds) while solving radii via a HiGHS LP at each step. A short backtracking scheme and occasional worst-circle relocation help escape local traps. We persist the best packing in lineage storage to warm-start future runs. Final safety shrink ensures strict feasibility.
